subject: 小南海石窟 · 窟门崖面局部
author: 三猎
source_note: 采用三猎 2016 年实拍的窟门外立面；照片未明确标示窟号，图注不擅定中窟。移除现代围栏，不复原残损造像。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink the relevant dynasty color in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.


SUBJECT-SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS:
Draw the actual exterior rock-cut cave entrance of Xiaonanhai Grottoes 小南海石窟, Anyang, as visible in photograph 2. This is a DETAIL OF THE CLIFF FACE, not the whole mountain and not an invented cave interior. The asymmetrical low rectangular rock-cut recess contains a small rounded doorway positioned to the RIGHT of its center, with an arched relief surround and damaged flanking figures. Preserve the irregular outer rock ledge, major fissures, low entrance position, the pair of small square holes left of the door, and the worn and broken relief shapes as observed. Keep the doorway and larger recess entirely WHITE with only thin outlines, no black fill. Do not add heads or hands to damaged figures, do not restore the missing carving, do not draw Buddha statues inside the opening. Remove metal fence and security grille, concrete roadside, tree branches, greenery, incense pot and all lettering/inscriptions. Show only a bounded complete section of the carved rock facade with a few tapered rock contours fading into white around its perimeter. Maintain the real roughly rectangular outside niche and smaller rounded opening within; do not make this a timber temple, a built masonry arched gateway, or an entire cavern. Restrained architectural contour line drawing with at least 75% white area, landscape 1536x1024.

historical_sources.title: 故宫博物院：小南海石窟
historical_sources.supports: 550—555 年开凿、僧稠、三窟布局及图像

historical_sources.title: 小南海石窟中窟
historical_sources.publisher: 中央研究院数位文化中心 佛教系统原型资料库
historical_sources.note: 中窟尺寸178×119×136厘米、坐北向南、窟前木构已毁、三壁三佛覆斗顶、可能作者方法师等、关系人僧稠、年代天保元年—乾明元年；引河南省古代建筑保护研究所《文物》1988年第4期及颜娟英1995年文

historical_sources.title: 小南海石窟东窟 / 西窟
historical_sources.publisher: 中央研究院数位文化中心 佛教系统原型资料库
historical_sources.note: 东窟位于中窟以东500米、略呈方形覆斗顶三壁三尊；西窟坐东朝西、高浮雕

historical_sources.title: 小南海石窟
historical_sources.note: 维基百科，二手来源（引文物出版社2004年《全国重点文物保护单位》）；三窟尺寸、东窟1999年搬迁至中窟东侧8米、风格近响堂山

historical_sources.title: A New Interpretation of the Textual Programme of “Sengchou's Cave” at Xiaonanhai
historical_sources.publisher: University of Vienna, Department of South Asian, Tibetan and Buddhist Studies
historical_sources.note: 1983年发掘、1988年发表；营建于550—560年、与僧稠（480—560）相关；中国最早在石上刻大段经文的实例。页面现返回404，内容据搜索摘要

site_recommendation.name: 小南海石窟
site_recommendation.yearNote: 故宫博物院记开凿于北齐天保元年至六年；553 仅作为这一时间区间的近似排序点，不指某一窟的确切竣工年。
site_recommendation.place: 河南 · 安阳市龙安区
site_recommendation.lede: 崖面内的低小洞口，仍可辨认门楣雕饰与门侧残像。小南海三窟保存了北齐佛教造像与净土图像的重要线索。

facts.label: 开凿年代
facts.text: 据故宫博物院，石窟开凿于北齐天保元年至六年（550—555），由僧稠最后完成。

facts.label: 三窟形制
facts.text: 东、中、西三窟均为覆斗方形、三壁三龛窟，佛像组合包括卢舍那、阿弥陀与弥勒。

facts.label: 图版范围
facts.text: 线稿取实拍中可见的窟门外立面局部，保留岩壁裂隙与门侧残损雕刻；不补绘窟内造像。
